description.en: Personal plugin market for the DeepSeek Harness: install plugins straight from GitHub repositories.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的个人插件市场：直接从 GitHub 仓库安装插件。

description.en: Adds a Skills panel to the sidebar, alongside Plugins, Automations and Usage: browse and manage every skill the Harness has loaded (global ~/.dsh/skills, user-level ~/.agents/skills, and each workspace's .dsh/skills / .agents/skills), with scope switching, search, Markdown details, on-by-default machine translation of descriptions and bodies, enable/disable, import, delete and open-folder.
description.zh: 在侧边栏新增「技能」独立面板（与「插件」「自动化任务」「使用统计」同级）：集中展示并管理当前加载到的全部技能（全局 ~/.dsh/skills、用户级 ~/.agents/skills，以及各工作区的 .dsh/skills 与 .agents/skills），支持作用域切换、搜索、Markdown 详情、描述与正文机器翻译（默认开启）、启停、导入、删除与打开目录。
